Scene:
  Type: Vast abandoned stone city in a rugged mountain valley
  Atmosphere: Quiet, hazy, overgrown
  Lighting: Soft daylight
Settlement layout:
  Buildings: Dozens upon dozens of roofless medieval buildings
  Distribution: Dense ruined districts on both riverbanks; tightest beside the river, thinning toward surrounding slopes
  Organization: Sprawling, tightly packed, distinctly unordered; architecture conforming to natural rock rather than a grid
  Local arrangement: Organic, along narrow dirt lanes, irregular courtyards, stepped rocky ground
  Bare spaces: A few broad bare courtyards amid denser blocks
Water and crossing:
  River: Pale turquoise, fast-flowing; winding through and dividing the settlement
  Bridge: Narrow arched stone bridge connecting the banks
Architecture:
  Material: Weathered gray masonry throughout
  Building types: Squat rectangular houses, taller blocky halls, broken towers
  Larger structures:
    Quantity: Several
    Style: Gothic
    Features: Pointed and rounded arches, arcades, buttress-like wall sections, partially collapsed upper stories
  Typical remains: Most retain only jagged exterior walls and exposed room divisions

  Scattered additions: Stairs, retaining walls, rubble piles, fallen logs, isolated masonry fragments among ruins
Terrain:
  Valley floor: Uneven brown earth; broad rock shelves, cliffs, large pale boulders, gullies
  Enclosure: Steep ridges
  Beyond city: Rocky, lightly forested mountains
Vegetation and mist:
  Placement: Open spaces and settlement edges
  Growth: Irregular mature leafy tree clusters, sparse woodland, scrub, grasses, weeds, small wildflowers
  Clouds: Low white clouds and mist threading between slopes and buildings
